subject: HealthScale implementation kickoff — handoff and next steps
messages:
From: Marcus Lin <marcus@redwood.com>
To: Tessa Morgan <tessa.morgan@redwood.com>, Lauren Bishop <lauren.bishop@redwood.com>
Cc: Aditya Rao <aditya.rao@redwood.com>, Dorothy Liu <dorothy.liu@healthscale.com>, Samir Patel <samir@healthscope.io>
Date: Fri, 30 Oct 2026 09:12:00 -0700
Subject: HealthScale implementation kickoff — handoff and next steps

Hi Tessa / Lauren,

Thanks again for a great close with HealthScale yesterday — they signed this morning and Aditya confirmed the PO is in flight. I'm looping you both in to start the post-sale workflow and to set expectations.

Quick context:
- Deal: HealthScale (enterprise) — primary use: clinical documentation summarization and search
- Committed capacity: dedicated pool (4 nodes), target go-live for initial pilot: Nov 17, 2026
- Key contacts: Dorothy Liu (CTO), Samir Patel (engineering lead)
- Signed artifacts: signed-quote.pdf (attached), MAP with milestones attached (HealthScale-MAP.xlsx)

Asks / questions for CS team:
1) Can CS lead the kickoff call and own the 0–30 day success plan? Prefer to schedule kickoff the week of Nov 1; customer proposed Nov 3 in their timezone.
2) Technical lead assignment: we expect an integration sprint for SSO (SAML), VPC peering, and model variant verification.
3) Any immediate risk flags (staffing/slot capacity) we should surface to the customer before kickoff?

I recommend Tessa take overall engagement lead and Lauren drive technical integration. Please confirm owners and I'll send the intro to Dorothy & Samir with calendar options.

Attachments: HealthScale-MAP.xlsx (workbook), signed-quote.pdf

Thanks,

Marcus Lin
Account Executive | Redwood Inference
marcus@redwood.com | +1 415-555-0123

From: Tessa Morgan <tessa.morgan@redwood.com>
To: Marcus Lin <marcus@redwood.com>, Lauren Bishop <lauren.bishop@redwood.com>
Cc: Aditya Rao <aditya.rao@redwood.com>
Date: Fri, 30 Oct 2026 10:05:00 -0700
Subject: Re: HealthScale implementation kickoff — handoff and next steps

Thanks Marcus — congrats team!

I'll take the engagement lead (0–90 day success plan). Lauren will own the technical integration. A few quick clarifying items before we lock the kickoff:
- What is the customer's SSO timeline? Marcus, you mentioned SAML — do they already have an IdP configured?
- Which cloud region will the dedicated pool be deployed in? (we should confirm AZ/region to ensure latency SLOs)
- Any strict data residency or logging retention requirements called out in the SOW?

I'll propose owners and a draft agenda for the kickoff (platform overview, security checklist, integration milestones, acceptance criteria) and share with the thread. If the customer prefers Nov 3, Lauren and I are available 11am–1pm PST for a technical sync.

Tessa

Hi Marcus / Tessa / Lauren,

Thanks Marcus — excited to get started. Joanna confirmed finance will issue the PO on Monday. Nov 3 at 11:30am PST works for us for the kickoff; we'll use Zoom and I'll share an invite shortly.

A couple items to surface ahead of the call:
- SSO: We have Okta configured and can provide SAML metadata during the kickoff. Samir will be the technical point for SSO work.
- VPC/networking: we'll need RFC for IP ranges and a preferred peering window (we generally schedule peering on Tues/Thurs mornings).
- Acceptance criteria: we want a short pilot (2 weeks) with clear latency and correctness checks; can you include a draft acceptance checklist in the kickoff agenda?

I've attached the MAP with a few internal dates filled in (HealthScale-MAP.xlsx). See you Wednesday.

Best,

Dorothy Liu
CTO, HealthScale
dorothy.liu@healthscale.com | +1 617-555-0199
